name: Performance mode (720p, faster lighting)
description: Trades image quality for speed: the game renders at 1280x720 instead of 1920x1080 and post-processes at 1664x936 instead of 2432x1368 (code patch for game version 01.019.000), and ray-traced lighting runs at half rate without the edge re-trace (softer edges). About +30-40% fps.
